There are no top-level downloads, executions, or data exfiltration attempts during sourcing.

Thus, simply sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of executing malicious code.
</details>

learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful fallback for LLM API errors to prevent a single transient failure from rendering the entire audit inconclusive.
